`/desk-fold` now folds again when only a desk-asana or desk-slack pane is open, and the note about the moved Asana and Slack panes no longer misses a connector that attaches late.

- `/desk-fold` with only the Asana or Slack pane open, after folding it once and opening it again, unfolded instead of folding. desk-asana and desk-slack now tell desk-look whether their pane is open (also when you close it with `✕`), so `/desk-fold` folds whenever any pane is open
- Folding again after opening another pane keeps the panes folded earlier, so the next `/desk-fold` brings all of them back
- The one-time note that the Asana and Slack panes moved now waits for each of the Asana and Slack MCP servers on its own: a local MCP server attaching first no longer ends the check before the claude.ai connectors arrive
- `/desk-update` updates desk-asana and desk-slack side by side
- The release check now also covers the shared helper file the two plugins copy

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
